title: Saved Models — implementation
summary: Allow users to save, load, clone, delete, version and export/import policy models as structured JSON behind a storage abstraction designed for future database migration. Tracks all implementation stories for this epic.
acceptance_criteria: A user can save the current model and reload it to an identical state
Clone and delete operate without corrupting other models
Models persist as versioned, structured JSON behind a storage interface
Export produces a portable file that import reconstructs faithfully
notes:
Scope (in): Save, load, clone, delete a model; Model metadata; Model versioning; Export / import; Structured JSON storage, DB-migration ready
Out of scope: User accounts/ownership (EPIC-005); Visibility (EPIC-006); Cross-user ranking (EPIC-007)
